title: Info Outreach
description: Participant info: outreach events (e.g. the outreach week before the conference and outreach Sabbath), project cards and a note

title.default: Faith in action: outreach in Katowice

text.default: Serve the city with us twice: come early for the outreach week before the conference, or join outreach Sabbath with everyone during the conference. [Confirm]

default.label: Before the conference
default.title: Outreach week
default.text: Come a week early and serve with a team of young people and local churches. Mornings of training and worship, afternoons and evenings out in the community.
default.items:
Door-to-door visits, health expo and children's programme [confirm]
Accommodation and meals arranged for the group [confirm]
Separate registration: places are limited
Cost: [€ –]

default.label: During the conference
default.title: Outreach Sabbath
default.text: On Sabbath afternoon we leave the venue and serve the city together. Everyone can join, whatever your experience.
default.items:
Included in your conference ticket
Choose your project when you register: places are limited
Teams leave after lunch [time]

projectsText.default: Choose your project when you register on the registration portal; places in each team are limited. [Confirm]

default.title: Statue from Daniel
default.text: Show people a portrait of the statue from Daniel 2, ask what it means to them, and invite the curious to a seminar. No experience needed.

default.title: How can we help Survey
default.text: Ask people what help they need, from gardening and cooking to natural remedies or Bible study, and offer real support.

default.title: Religious Liberty Survey
default.text: Talk with people about freedom of belief using a short survey.

default.title: Singing
default.text: Sing in squares and streets and invite people to the evening programme.

default.title: Tracts Distribution & Pathfinder Club Flyer Distribution
default.text: Hand out tracts and invite families to the local Pathfinder Club.

default.title: Books Distribution
default.text: Share books and invitations across the city in teams.

default.title: Prayer Walk
default.text: Walk the city in small groups and pray for the people of Katowice.

default.title: Prayer Room
default.text: Pray for the teams in the city and for the people they meet.

note.default: Under 18? Join an outreach team together with your chaperone. [Confirm]
